title: Subpoena duces tecum
intro: A subpoena duces tecum (pronounced in English  sə-PEE-nə DEW-seez TEE-kəm), or subpoena for production of evidence, is a court summons ordering the recipient to appear before the court and produce documents or other tangible evidence for use at a hearing or trial. In some jurisdictions, it can also be issued by legislative bodies such as county boards of supervisors.

title: Subquotient
intro: In the mathematical fields of category theory and abstract algebra, a subquotient is a quotient object of a subobject. Subquotients are particularly important in abelian categories, and in group theory, where they are also known as sections, though this conflicts with a different meaning in category theory.

title: Substantial part (Canadian copyright law)
intro: It is an infringement in Canadian copyright law for any person to do, without the consent of the owner of the copyright, anything that only the copyright owner has a right to do as covered in the Copyright Act.

title: Substitution (logic)
intro:
A substitution is a syntactic transformation on formal expressions.
To apply a substitution to an expression means to consistently replace its variable, or placeholder, symbols with other expressions.

title: Sufficient statistic
intro: In statistics, sufficiency is a property of a statistic computed on a sample dataset in relation to a parametric model of the dataset. A sufficient statistic for a model parameter contains all of the information that the dataset provides about that parameter.

title: Sum-check protocol
intro: A sum-check protocol is a cryptographic protocol for the construction of interactive proof systems, used widely in zero-knowledge protocols.

title: Sum of four cubes problem
intro: The sum of four cubes problem asks whether every integer is the sum of four cubes of integers.  It is conjectured the answer is affirmative, but this conjecture has been neither proven nor disproven, at least as reported in 1982 by Philippe Revoy and again in 2004 by Henri Cohen.

title: Sum of normally distributed random variables
resolved_title: Sum of normally distributed random variables
intro:
In probability theory, calculation of the sum of normally distributed random variables is an instance of the arithmetic of random variables.
This is not to be confused with the sum of normal distributions which forms a mixture distribution.

title: Sum of residues formula
intro: In mathematics, the residue formula says that the sum of the residues of a meromorphic differential form on a smooth proper algebraic curve vanishes.
